slides.title: Window = [[dono]] milega
slides.note: Khidki se poori class dikhti hai, par tum **apni seat** pe hi baithe ho 🪑

slides.title: Pehla [[OVER()]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary,
  AVG(salary) OVER ()
    AS company_avg
FROM employees;

slides.title: Rows [[safe]] hain
slides.note: 5 rows andar, **5 rows bahar**. Meera avg se thoda neeche 👀

slides.title: Window ki [[family]]
slides.note: MySQL mein window functions **8.0+** se hi chalte hain

slides.right:
SELECT name FROM (
  SELECT name, salary,
    AVG(salary) OVER () AS a
  FROM employees) t
WHERE salary > a;
slides.why: Window WHERE ke **baad** chalta hai. Subquery/CTE mein lapeto 📦
